highlight.text: Points for Nejmeh. Next: wait on Istiklol vs. Homs Al Fidaa.

caption:
Nejmeh beat Al Arabi 3-1 in the AFC Challenge League, coming from behind on matchday 3. ⚽

The win takes Nejmeh to six points in Group B. Their place in the quarter-finals now depends on the group's other game, Istiklol vs. Homs Al Fidaa.

Who was your man of the match? 🇱🇧
